articles.title: Bitcoin's $19 billion wake-up call: One-year after flash crash, has crypto learned anything?
articles.snippet: The Oct. 10, 2025 flash crash wiped out billions in leveraged crypto bets. Traders now have better tools to spot risks, but the forces behind the selloff remain.

articles.title: Thailand opens door to locally listed bitcoin and ether ETFs
articles.snippet: Thailand’s new crypto rules taking effect Oct. 16. They allow Thai asset managers to launch crypto ETFs on the local stock exchange, with bitcoin and ether initially eligible.

articles.title: New tech to power bitcoin lending is set to debut with $500 million in commitments
articles.snippet: Layer-1 blockchain Sui is launching Hashi, an institutional protocol allowing holders to use bitcoin as collateral without moving it off the Bitcoin network.

articles.title: XRP Ledger adds new controls for banks, stablecoins and tokenized funds
articles.snippet: The feature lets businesses give separate accounts limited powers such as approving customers or making payments, while keeping the keys that control their main holdings offline.

articles.title: Tech chief says EU can fend off rogue AI risk: Report
articles.snippet: There are global concerns following incidents at OpenAI ‌and Anthropic, and fears have arisen that rogue AI agents may venture beyond human control.
